findings.says: The server lists @shadcn as configured, then a search that names no registry says "No registries are configured". Codex hit this in its own first search and had to retry with @shadcn. This breaks "The registries get_project_registries lists are the ones a search covers when no registry is named."

evidence.saw: get_project_registries: "- @shadcn"; search_items_in_registries {query: date picker}: "No registries are configured. Add registries to components.json"

evidence.got: Codex's own first search, {query: date-picker} with no registry, got "No registries are configured". It searched again with registries: ["@shadcn"].

findings.says: The refusal names the wrong next step: it tells the agent to add registries to components.json, but @shadcn is already set up. The step that works is passing registries: ["@shadcn"].

evidence.saw: "Add registries to components.json (use get_project_registries to inspect) or pass them explicitly."
